senses.gloss: one of a pair of pigeons, single pigeon, opp. to קֵן.
units: Kinn. III, 6 צריכה … פ׳ אחת she is bound to offer a single pigeon in addition; Zeb. 67ᵇ. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. VIII, Par. 7; Zeb. 65ᵃ אפי׳ פ׳ אחת וכ׳ he may offer even one single pigeon; a. fr.—Pl. פְּרִידִין (m.), פְּרִידוֹת. Kinn. l. c. דין … Bab. ed. (Mish. ed. דות …). Sifra l. c.; a. fr.—Trnsf. a dear person.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:11">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ אחת יש לי … ואי אתם וכ׳</he> one pigeon (my son’s body) is among you, and you will not let him come to me (be buried by my side)? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ … ואתם וכ׳</he> I have a dear son among you, and you want to deprive me of him (expose him to the evil eye by showing him too much honor)?—Pl. <he>פְּרִידוֹת</he>.
B. Kam. 38ᵇ שתי פ׳ טובות וכ׳ two fine pigeons (precious proselytes) do I expect to bring forth from among you (v. בָּרַךְ Hif.).

senses.gloss: a single berry; a slice of a pomegranate.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ</cite> top <he>פ׳ אחת של ענב</he> one grape berry; <he>פ׳ אחת של רמון</he> one slice of a pomegranate.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:1:7">Y. Naz. VI, 54ᵈ</cite> [read:] <he>פ׳ של רמון … שחלקה בפיו ואכלה</he> a piece of a pomegranate of ʿOrlah (v. <cite ref="P01387"><he>עָרְלָה</he></cite>) which one cut off with his mouth and ate.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2:5">Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Niddah 27a:53">Nidd. 27ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>על פ׳ אחת של רקב</he> to one particle of decayed matter; <he>על פ׳ אחת של עפר</he> to one particle of earth.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:5">Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ</cite> top <he>ברוב כל פ׳ ופ׳</he> (the fire must have seized) the larger portion of every particle, opp. <he>רובו של קומץ</he> the larger portion of the handful (of the meal offering); a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּרִידוֹת</he>. Nidd. l. c.—[<cite ref="Q01791"><he>פרידה</he></cite> ch., v. <cite ref="Q01789"><he>פְּרִידָא</he> I</cite>.]
